name: Inpainting for Displaced Objects
definition: Remedies black smudges and dirty textures caused by displaced objects exposing unseen areas by removing kernels and inpainting.
summary: Inpainting for Displaced Objects fixes black smudges from displaced 3D Gaussian Splatting objects by removing kernels, inpainting the resulting holes with generative AI, and reinitializing the removed kernels with the new colors.
